data.body: This paragraph says the workflow removes `needs-info` "then adds `needs-triage`", but `run()` in `scripts/close_stale_issues.py` calls `gh_add_label` before `gh_remove_label` — deliberately, per the new `test_adds_triage_label_before_removing_needs_info` test, so that a failed add leaves `needs-info` in place instead of stranding the issue without either label. The doc describes the reverse (and less safe) order, which could mislead a future contributor into "fixing" the code to match the doc and reintroducing that gap.
